items.title: Show HN: Yulin Local AWS Simulator
items.contentSnippet:
For the last few months I've been working on Yulin, which is an AWS simulator for Node.js. It simulates AWS services and state in memory in the same single process as your tests, and can also serve the simulation on localhost for local dev. It's in a similar conceptual space to LocalStack, but takes a very different approach by avoiding containers and keeping everything together in one process that you can step through in a debugger.

items.title: Show HN: Minilith – A zero-dependency CMS stored inside a PNG file
items.contentSnippet:
I enjoy the constraints of retro development. While building games in PICO-8, I took a interest in the way it packs data into the virtual cartridge. I dug into steganography and started thinking: could I apply the same logic to a content management system? Do we really need all the bloat just to host a micro blog?
Minilith is a database free CMS where the entire state (posts, pages, and settings) are compressed and stored directly in the pixels of a 256xd256 PNG file.
